Templates.uppercase.Name: UPPERCASE
Templates.uppercase.Description: Converts the entire text to uppercase.
Templates.lowercase.Name: lowercase
Templates.lowercase.Description: Converts the entire text to lowercase.
Templates.trim.Name: Trim whitespace
Templates.trim.Description: Removes whitespace before and after the text.
Templates.clean-spacing.Name: Clean up spacing
Templates.clean-spacing.Description: Collapses repeated spaces and tabs and keeps paragraphs.
Templates.bullets.Name: Markdown bullet list
Templates.bullets.Description: Turns each non-empty line into a bullet; existing bullets are kept.
Templates.checklist.Name: Markdown checklist
Templates.checklist.Description: Turns each non-empty line into a task; existing checkboxes are kept.
Templates.quote.Name: Markdown quotation
Templates.quote.Description: Quotes every line, including paragraph breaks.
Templates.json.Name: JSON string
Templates.json.Description: Escapes the text as one JSON string, including quotes and line breaks.
Templates.url.Name: URL-encode text
Templates.url.Description: Encodes a query parameter value, not a complete URL.
